tools.title: Tools
tools.subtitle: Small working tools I build for myself. Everything runs in the browser and the data stays on your device.
tools.metaDescription: Interactive tools: applications that run entirely in the browser and keep their data locally.

career.title: Career Control Center
career.description: A visual board for career movement: today's actions, campaign progress, market funnel, engineering evidence and interview readiness.

career.title: Career Control Center
career.subtitle: AI Engineering Career Campaign
career.metaDescription: A tool for running a career campaign: today's actions, progress, market signals and engineering evidence. Runs locally in the browser.

today.title: Today
today.estimateHint: A rough estimate, not a quota
today.noteZero: One meaningful step is enough to keep the campaign alive.
today.notePartial: {{done}} done. That is a trace — the day is not lost.
today.noteComplete: Everything required for today is closed.
today.milestoneToday: A campaign milestone is scheduled for today.

quick.title: Quick actions
quick.hint: One click, one event. Right-click a button to add a comment.

scoreboard.title: Career scoreboard
scoreboard.nonZeroHint: A day counts as real if it left at least one trace

day.title: Day {{day}}
day.marketSignalHint: Record an external signal for this day

funnel.title: Market funnel
funnel.hintEmpty: No applications yet — the funnel has nothing to show.
funnel.hintPositioning: {{applications}} applications and no responses: the problem is likely positioning, the CV, or which vacancies you target.
funnel.hintDiagnostic: The funnel is a diagnostic, not a grade. Look for the stage where movement stops.

knowledge.title: Knowledge matrix
knowledge.hint: Click a cell to change a topic's status. CONFIRMED means you can explain it, apply it and answer questions about it.
knowledge.confirmedHint: Confirmed topics: explained, applied, questions answered.

readiness.title: Interview readiness
readiness.disclaimer: This is not a probability of passing an interview. It is an internal preparation indicator: a weighted sum of four counters.

activity.title: Activity
activity.empty: Nothing yet. Your first recorded action will show up here.

heatmap.title: Activity map
heatmap.hint: Intensity is the number of meaningful actions per day, not hours spent.

week.title: Week {{week}}
week.noOutcome: No events for this week yet.

parking.title: Parking lot
parking.hint: A place for ideas that must not steal the current focus. Landing here does not count as a task.

changelog.title: Career changelog
changelog.empty: No entries yet. Milestones and notable campaign events will appear here.

start.title: Create a campaign
start.lead: The campaign lives in this browser only: no account, no server. Pick a start date and a length.
start.restoreHint: Already have a backup file? Restore the state instead of starting over.

recovery.title: Local data could not be read
recovery.lead: The stored state is corrupted or incompatible. Nothing has been overwritten — choose what to do.
recovery.note: Until you choose, the existing localStorage record is left untouched.

complete.title: Campaign complete
complete.lead: {{days}} days behind you. Below is data, not congratulations: the next cycle is built on it.
complete.confirmNew: Start a new campaign? The current one will be kept in history.
complete.note: The next cycle builds on this one: market numbers, technical gaps and interview weak spots are already collected.

settings.dataHint: localStorage is tied to this browser, can be cleared and does not sync between devices. Export is the only way to truly own your data.

importErrors.parse: The file is not valid JSON. No existing data was changed.
importErrors.invalid: This does not look like a Career Control Center backup. No existing data was changed.
importErrors.versionTooNew: The file was created by a newer version of the tool. No existing data was changed.
importErrors.migration: The data in this file could not be migrated. No existing data was changed.

settings.dangerHint: Both actions require confirmation and cannot be undone. Export first if in doubt.
settings.confirmReset: Reset the current campaign? Checkmarks, events and statuses will be removed; settings and history stay.
settings.confirmDelete: Delete all local data for this tool? This cannot be undone.
settings.privacyText: Your campaign, notes and events never leave the browser: the tool has no backend, no accounts and no sync, and sends nothing outward. Once loaded, it works offline. The site as a whole runs a visit counter — it sees that a page was opened, not what is on it.
